name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.107.0 — the default test-classification glob set is single-sourced: `lib/host-config.js`'s `DEFAULT_TEST_GLOBS` is now the sole declaration and is frozen, with `scope-reconcile.js` (main at-risk derivation + `--probe-at-risk`) and `init-gen.js`'s applicability probe importing it instead of re-declaring identical literals; `init-gen.js`'s copy had never been inside the AC-20260906-01-8 equality pin at all. That pin is inverted from two-copy equality to single-sourcing — it walks spec/scripts/ and reddens on ANY second declaration — which retires the AC's source-read equality clause (docs/adr/0011; its host-declared-testGlobs clause is unchanged and still covered). No behaviour change: the literals were verified byte-identical and every read site is a membership test. 7.106.1 — spec/templates/grounding-contract.md's Render gate section no longer asserts that the plugin never launches a browser: the clause now scopes that rule to `--spec` mode and names the mock-only `--mocks` fallback to the plugin's own dependency-free capture (ADR-0007, 2026-09-05), which fails closed when no browser is found. Prose only; hosts owe a /spec:doctor re-stamp because the contract hash changes. 7.106.0 — the at-risk selector no longer hands ignored working copies to a host's test command: `scope-reconcile.js`'s `walkTestFiles` derives an ignored-path set once per process from `git ls-files -o -i --exclude-standard --directory -z` (guarded to only apply when `--root` is the repository top level and both git calls exit clean), pruning git-ignored directories and files during the walk while leaving the four existing name skips (`.git`, `node_modules`, `fixtures`, `__fixtures__`) untouched; `--probe-at-risk` inherits the same prune through the shared call. `review-legs.js` widens the at-risk and suite legs' forcing predicate from an observed `testsExecuted === 0` to also cover `{"unavailable":"pattern-no-match"}` — a host that declares a test-count format and never matches it now reds both legs instead of passing a run that executed nothing; a host declaring no format at all is unaffected.
